_comment: This file lists the kinds of file a project of this core can hold. A project supplies the game's data file as firmware (waterbox.config); the one slot is the game's saves.

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: The game's saves as Emulator > Export Save Data wrote them: SData.bin (the save slots' progress) and SGame.bin, under those names. They are put in place before the game starts, so the game finds them as its own. A file with another name is refused.
